transport.channel_reuse: one channel per exact active route
transport.dns_policy: all resolved addresses must pass the deployment allowlist

admission.backpressure: retain exact route-bound input in bounded WAL

retry.same_generation_equivalent_worker_set: exact BindingReadback.eligible_workers set, bounded to 64 unique worker identities
retry.result_worker_requirement: worker_id and worker_digest must be an exact eligible pair; worker_attempt_id must be a non-empty stable identity
retry.deadline_scope: one global monotonic budget shared by all attempts and backoffs
retry.conflict_identity_retention: retain request_id and input_digest until the caller deadline; live entries are never evicted
retry.cancellation: gRPC deadline plus local monotonic timeout-at-global-deadline
retry.late_result: reject at the complete result fence

triton_execution_expectation.edge_verification: exact runtime_profile and runtime_profile_digest central readback

output_adapter_binding.parameter_source: digest-pinned repository closure member with role=bundle-manifest
output_adapter_binding.adapter_digest_preimage: canonical JSON of output_adapter without the adapter_digest field (sorted keys, no whitespace)
output_adapter_binding.envelope_cross_check: startup rejects unless the envelope feature/label/output_adapter digests equal the bundle-manifest digests
output_adapter_binding.decision_rule: top-1 over canonical class-ordered scores; abstain iff top-1 < label_taxonomy.threshold.value; else alert iff predicted_label != baseline_label and top-1 >= output_adapter.threshold; else benign
output_adapter_binding.ood_rule: out_of_distribution iff maximum canonical normalized score is below output_adapter.ood_policy.threshold; OOD always forces abstain
output_adapter_binding.canonical_score_encoding: repeated float32 little-endian in canonical class order
output_adapter_binding.result_batch_digest_preimage: ordered output_digest strings, each followed by one newline byte

binding_digest_preimages.runtime_profile_digest: sha256 over the exact bytes of contracts/inference/v1/model-runtime-central-cpu.json for the CPU profile
binding_digest_preimages.optimization_profile_digest: sha256 over the exact bytes of contracts/inference/v1/optimization-profile-central-cpu.json
binding_digest_preimages.model_revision_digest: sha256 over canonical JSON of bundle-manifest binding_identity (sorted keys, no whitespace)
binding_digest_preimages.startup_cross_check: Gateway recomputes all three preimages and rejects before readiness on any mismatch

repository_closure.triton_model_name_source: first path component of the role=model member rel_path
repository_closure.closure_digest_preimage: sorted lines of "role\trel_path\tmember_digest" joined by "\n" with a trailing "\n"
repository_closure.read_only: no write bit for owner/group/other on any entry
repository_closure.symlink_policy: reject any symlink in the tree
